04. 1. The Appellant by filing this Application under section- 389 of the Cr.P.C. has prayed for suspension of execution of sentence imposed upon him for the conviction recorded under section-376(2)(f)/376(2)(i)/506(II) of the IPC and section 6 of the POCSO Act by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Court under the POCSO Act, Cuttack in Special G.R. Case No.64 of 2017, pending disposal of this Appeal.

Learned counsel for the Appellant at the outset instead of pressing the application for grant of bail to the Appellant, confines his submission for grant of interim bail to the Appellant and prays for disposal of this application accordingly.

sentences.text: 2. Heard learned counsel for the Appellant and learned counsel for the State.

3. Taking into account the submissions made and on going through the judgment passed by the Trial Court as well as the depositions of the prosecution witnesses, further keeping in view the role said to have been played by this Appellant and the manner in which the incident had taken place as emerge from the evidence; I am not inclined to grant bail to the Appellant pending disposal of this Appeal.

However, keeping in view the long period of detention of the Appellant in custody by now; it is directed that he (Ramesh Chandra Nayak @ Basti) be released on interim bail for a period of ten (10) weeks from the date of his actual release from custody in connection with the aforementioned case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the Trial Court with further conditions that the Appellant shall not indulge himself in any criminal activity during the period of interim bail and shall positively surrender before the Trial Court as would be so directed by the said Court on expiry of period of interim bail.
4. The I.A. is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy of this order on proper application.

(D. Dash), Judge ORDER 16.05.2024 Order No.
05. 1.
List this matter on 23rd September, 2024 for hearing.
